text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P1 calibration. Current GLS still exposes representative normalizedCovariance under voxelwise whitening while coefficientCovariance is voxelwise; FixedEffects still sums nominal run residual df. Use public contrast uncertainty and empirical repeated-sampling variance as the study endpoints. The consumer protocol and Step-0 report exist, but the report explicitly says no first-level fit and no provider qualification. Current main GroupWeighting supports OLS/FE/DL and has no GroupModel.mixedEffects PM/mKH path, so native d_crit confirmation first requires the adopted group baseline from bd-01M20TKX7VYFT3BHCM7QAMA6NG. Correct historical overclaims: d_crit=12 is conditional on the tested grid/model/reference; it does not prove every modest df shortfall harmless, interpolate all untested df/configurations, or establish safety under dependent/non-chi-square estimated variances. Treat summed df optimism and feasible-GLS variance excess/order as hypotheses to measure under explicit conditions, not universal conclusions supplied by source inspection. Preserve adverse outcomes, d_eff/d_inv disagreement and simulator validation. Reconcile/hash the protocol before confirmation and separate native baseline qualification from synthetic group threshold work. No Monte Carlo or candidate confirmation was run in this assessment.
